info.title: MAYSTROON Public API
info.description: Published public content and verified-session administration. Android consumers use JSON; write requests send the configured site Origin.

body.description: Plain text; HTTP links and HTML rejected

post.summary: Decode image and upload original plus derivatives

file.description: JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF/GIF <=5 MiB; hosting transport limit can be lower.
